score.detail.edit.description: Fields other than title and composer are optional. Leave unknown fields blank.
score.detail.edit.form.title: Title
score.detail.edit.form.internationalTitl:
If the title is not in Latin script, enter a romanized version.
If no transliteration is needed, enter the original title as is.
score.detail.edit.form.song.title: Song Title
score.detail.edit.form.subtitle: Subtitle
score.detail.edit.form.internationalSubt:
If the subtitle is not in Latin script, enter a romanized version.
If no transliteration is needed, enter the original as is.
score.detail.edit.form.instrument.hint:
Regardless of the number of voice parts, enter "1 Choir" for single choir or "2 Choirs" for double choir, etc.

For vocal solos, select "Solo/Soli Singer in a Choir" if a choir member sings solo, or select the voice part (e.g., "Alto") for independent soloists.

For optional instruments, select the instrument and drag it into the dotted box in the form.
score.detail.edit.form.duration.hint: Even if no reference duration is listed in the score or publisher's website, you may enter an approximate time based on actual performances. Leave at 0 if unknown.
score.detail.edit.form.premieredYear.hin: Enter the year when the work was first publicly performed or presented (not the publication year). Leave blank if unknown.
score.detail.edit.form.publisher.languag: Set all languages used in the publication, including commentary and notes, not just the score itself.
score.detail.edit.form.publishUrl.hint: Please enter the official publisher's page or authorized retailer URL if possible.
score.detail.edit.form.minNumberOfSinger: Usually enter the maximum number of divisi in each voice part. However, if multiple singers per part are expected (e.g., staggered entries), this may not apply. If specific numbers are difficult to determine, leave all voice parts at 0.

subscription.title: Pricing & Plans
subscription.description: ChoralLib offers many features for free and is completely free for personal use. By subscribing to a paid plan, you can access homepage-equivalent features for your official page.
subscription.section.personal.title: Personal Use
subscription.section.personal.subtitle: All Free
subscription.section.personal.feature1: Search scores, composers, videos, and more
subscription.section.personal.feature2: Advanced search by difficulty, mood, and other criteria
subscription.section.personal.feature5: Create and publish your personal page
subscription.section.official.title: Official Pages
subscription.section.official.subtitle: Choirs, artists, composers, and lyricists can set up their own official pages.
subscription.section.official.feature4.n: e.g. conductor and instructor profiles for ensembles
subscription.section.official.feature7: List event and concert info on the site-wide event calendar
subscription.section.official.feature9.n: Logged-in users can follow your page and receive automatic email notifications when you post updates
subscription.section.steps.title: How to Set Up an Official Page
subscription.section.steps.step1.title: Create an account
subscription.section.steps.step1.descrip: Sign in easily with your Google account.
subscription.section.steps.step2.title: Request an official page
subscription.section.steps.step2.descrip: Apply to manage a page from the choir, artist, composer, or lyricist screen.
subscription.section.steps.step3.title: Review & approval
subscription.section.steps.step3.descrip: Our team will review your request and grant editing access upon approval.
subscription.section.steps.step4.title: Start editing with free features
subscription.section.steps.step4.descrip: Begin using free features like adding your profile and social links right away.
subscription.section.steps.step5.title: Subscribe to a paid plan
subscription.section.steps.step5.descrip: Unlock advanced features like blog posting, contact forms, and more.
subscription.section.steps.step6.title: Unlock full potential
subscription.section.steps.step6.descrip: Leverage all official page features to showcase your ensemble or profile.
